incidents.name: Unverified router 0x05f0 unprotected swap entry point
incidents.notes: The unverified router exposed selector 0xf6ebebbb with no caller or slippage validation, letting a flash-loan-funded attacker drive its internal swap accounting and walk away with the contract's USDC, WBTC, WETH and USDT balances.

sources.ref: onchain review: router 0x05f016765c6c601fd05a10dba1abe21a04f924a5 created 2023-10-17T13:43:59Z by 0x1bda91e3a2e332428cf1a407821abecec0395427, unrelated to the attack sender; unverified, no EIP-1967 events, age from deployment (21.4 days). Loss ~$2M per BlockSec's alert.
